system.description: Your face is hideous, but could almost pass for that of a really ugly human. If every other part of your body is covered, you can shamble into mortal society, with extensive precautions, without automatically breaking the Masquerade. Other Nosferatu give you no end of grief for not looking like a "real" Sewer Rat. This is as attractive as a Nosferatu ever gets; no Merit ever raises a Nosferatu's Appearance-related Traits above zero.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
